Hi Maria —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Attached is a first-pass MAP and a short SOC2 evidence summary so your procurement and security teams can start reviewing in parallel. High level notes in the doc:

- Proposed initial commitment: 40 x A100-equivalent GPUs (Dedicated pool) for 6 months, with a staged scale to 120 GPUs after month 3 based on performance/throughput gates.
- Lead times: Dedicated reservation (hosted/dedicated) can be provisioned on our reserved pools in ~6–8 weeks from signed commitment; Private (VPC or on-prem package) typical lead time is 12–16 weeks depending on KMS/HSM and network work.
- Acceptance gates (QA): integration smoke test, 72-hour production soak at 80% of expected sustained concurrency, and perf regression check against your baseline eval set.
- Payment & billing: monthly invoicing for committed capacity with overage at metered rate.

As next steps I recommend:
1) Procurement reviews attached MAP and SOC2 summary this week (I noted a few items in the doc that need procurement/IT input).
2) We run a short eval window (two-week sandbox) once we have the initial tranche live — this will validate batch sizes and expected tail latencies.
3) Target signature (commitment) by Fri, Jun 4 to hit the 6–8 week provision window for a mid-July Dedicated handoff.

Can you confirm if staggered delivery is acceptable to Stratton (i.e., an initial tranche of 40 then two tranches of 40)? Also please attach your procurement timeline so we can align.

Folks — forwarding Stratton's procurement reply. Key asks: smaller initial tranche (30/90), potential pre-work to accelerate private lead time, tighter soak if perf within 5%, and 24/7 SRE for first two weeks (likely a billable add-on).

Quick internal assessment:
- Feasibility: Dedicated pool 6–8 weeks still achievable. If they go Private (VPC + customer-managed network or on-prem), we should expect 12–16 weeks; network and KMS coordination are the main blockers. We can accelerate by running network prep (VPN, firewall rules, KMS handshake) prior to signature as a scoped professional-services engagement.
- Sizing: Our suggested mapping to SKU: 30 GPUs (initial tranche) -> should be a combination of 8 x 4-GPU nodes + 2 x 2-GPU for headroom; scale to 90 by staging additional nodes in two tranches.
- Acceptance/Ops: We can agree to 48-hour soak if we add a perf-safety clause: if tail latency exceeds baseline by >5% after 48 hours, we move to 72-hour soak. That gives the customer a faster path but protects Redwood against false positives.
- Cost: propose committing to 6 months on tranche 1 with a 3-month ramp clause; overage rates apply. Also propose optional 24/7 SRE for first 14 days at a fixed daily rate + on-call phone support.

Action items for Ben/Vivek:
1) Ben — confirm whether the Dedicated pool calendar can absorb a staggered 30 then 90 tranche and confirm tentative provision dates if signed by Jun 4.
2) Vivek — confirm service add-on pricing for 24/7 SRE and whether PS network-prep can be scoped for pre-signature work.
3) Marissa — update MAP doc with the acceptance clause and tranche breakdown; I'll coordinate with Maria for the exact dates.
